lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 7 distinct white vertical lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is irregular: the first two anterior lines are widely separated, followed by a cluster of three lines in the mid-torso, and two final lines on the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior line terminates mid-way down the shoulder. The third vertical line is an abbreviated segment restricted to the upper third of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low density cluster consisting of 2-3 distinct white spots located on the lateral posterior haunch above the knee joint.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The visible horn displays a spiral lyrate trajectory, angling posteriorly from the pedicle before curving upward and inward towards the terminal tip.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory tip constitutes approximately 15% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white dorsal crest of long hair extends from the neck to the rump. Facial markings include a white chevron between the eyes and two distinct white spots on the cheek/mandible area.
